The new Northern Ireland Protocol was negotiated between the UK and the EU to replace the provisions on Northern Ireland in the Withdrawal Agreement.

As part of the Protocol, the UK Government has committed to introducing a series of checks on goods moving from Great Britain to Northern Ireland.
